//@version=6
indicator("V52 qualifier-format-time-input-format-active", calc_bars_count=32)
sourceTime = 0
formatText = input.string("yyyy", "Format")
value = str.format_time(time=sourceTime, format=formatText, timezone="UTC")
consumer = input.bool(true, "Consumer", active=value == "1970")
plot(consumer ? 1 : 0, "CONSUMER")
plot(str.length(value), "TARGET_LENGTH")
plot(value == "1970" ? 1 : 0, "TARGET_EQUAL")
plot(na(value) ? 1 : 0, "TARGET_NA")
if barstate.isfirst
    log.info("TARGET=[{0}]", value)
plot(bar_index, "INDEX")
plot(close, "CONTROL_CLOSE")
